# Portfolio image mapping

The portfolio uses the image files from `D:\Portfolio\Images`, copied into `public/images` so Vite can serve them.

- `1.png`: Branch Directory
- `2.png`–`3.png`: Account Monitoring Systems
- `4.png`–`16.png`: CRM
- `17.png`: Memo Registry
- `18.png`–`26.png`: Document Management System
- `27.png`: RIKKA V2
- `Profile picture.png`: profile image

The local folder contains 27 numbered images. The website uses the files that actually exist and does not invent missing screenshots.

Before publishing internal project screenshots, remove or blur real names, email addresses, account numbers, customer information, credentials, exact locations, and other company-sensitive data.
